<title level="1" pfs="">[Protoceratops](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3261)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Though it lacks the distinctive horns of its larger relative the [triceratops](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2921), the protoceratops is more than capable of holding its own in combat, using its tail to knock enemies to the ground and its sturdy frill to turn away blows.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 16

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Dinosaur_Protoceratops.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Protoceratops](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3261)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
<trait label="Dinosaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=576" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 136

**Perception** +9; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +8

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +2

**Con** +3

**Int** -4

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +1
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +11 

**Ref** +8 

**Will** +6 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 30

</row>

**Frill Block** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Requirements** The protoceratops is in its Defensive Posture; **Trigger** An adjacent ally would take damage from a physical attack; **Effect** The protoceratops partially blocks the blow with its frill, reducing the damage by 5.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
head +10,
**Damage** 1d8+4 bludgeoning

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tail +10 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 1d6+4 bludgeoning plus [Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=46)

**Defensive Posture** <actions string="Single Action" />  The protoceratops tucks in its head and presents its sturdy frill, granting a +1 circumstance bonus to AC adjacent allies. The protoceratops remains in its Defensive Posture until the start of its next turn, but only grants the bonus while allies remain adjacent.

</column>
